_comment: Display config for Sri Lanka. Coherence-only (Level 1): no BTR / BER / NR7 data, so no btrMitigationSourceRef, countrySectors, or mitigationTaxonomy. Document taxonomy and provenance drive the dashboard with no code changes (same shape as panama-country-config.json).
name: Sri Lanka
_anchorDocTypeComment: Intentionally omitted. anchorDocType drives the Vision Anchor Coverage view, which treats one document as the country's north-star/long-term vision that every other doc operationalises (Mongolia: Vision 2050 = SECTORAL). Sri Lanka's three documents (NDC, NBSAP, LDN) are parallel convention commitments (climate / nature / land), not a vision-and-derivatives hierarchy, so no anchor is set and that view stays off.
_documentTypesComment: Sri Lanka's eight source documents. NDC/NBSAP/LDN from data_sri_lanka_15Jun26.xlsx: shortLabel / fullLabel verbatim from the xlsx Doc and Document columns, mediumLabel parenthetical = verbatim Convention column value. NAP/PPPP/NMP/NWRP are expert-curated from data_sri_lanka_2Jul26.xlsx (NMP/NWRP from its 2 Jul evening extension); NFAP is pipeline-extracted and expert-approved: fullLabel verbatim from the xlsx Document column / the document's own front matter, parenthetical = the sector domain. NMP objective is the policy's Vision (p.3) verbatim; NMP states no issuing author in its front matter (inquiries contact only), so author is omitted. Colors from the UNDP-compatible Tailwind palette; avoids reserved red (#dc2626 political sensitivity), BTR purple (#7c3aed), and OTHER grey (#78716c); mutually distinguishable.
_documentMetaComment: Reference metadata (docKind / published / author / url / objective) for the doc-focus panel; urls verified to return HTTP 200 on 2026-06-30 by reading each document's front matter. NDC 3.0 and LDN are direct PDFs (UNFCCC / UNCCD) and their objectives are near-verbatim from each document's cover letter. NBSAP: the Kunming-Montreal-aligned update is still in preparation and no public draft PDF was found, so no url / date / objective is set (the 2016-2022 NBSAP and the 2024 National Policy on Biodiversity are different documents and were not substituted). The NBSAP targets and actions carried here are the country's own draft, shared with the project by the CO on 2026-07-17.
_docClassComment: Machine-readable document classification (docClass) and national-hierarchy level (docTier) consumed by src/lib/doc-taxonomy. Added Aug 2026 for parity with Panama. THE VOCABULARY IS PROJECT-DEFINED (see DOC_CLASSES in src/lib/doc-taxonomy); EACH ASSIGNMENT TRACES TO THE DOCUMENT'S OWN SELF-DESCRIPTION recorded in docKind below, never its subject matter: NDC is a contribution declared to the UNFCCC and LDN declares country targets to the UNCCD (commitment, tier 2; no tier-1 instrument exists in this corpus - the corpus has no unifying national vision document, so tier 1 is intentionally empty). NBSAP calls itself a Strategy and Action Plan (sector_strategy, tier 3). NAP (the National Agriculture Policy, per its docKind note NOT a National Adaptation Plan), NWRP, NFAP and NMP each self-describe as a national sectoral policy - the vocabulary's closest class is sector_plan (tier 3); 'policy' vs 'plan' is noted as an approximation. PPPP self-describes as the national physical planning policy and plan, a spatial planning instrument (territorial_instrument, tier 3 - national scope, unlike Panama's subnational PIOTA at tier 4). BTR is not in this corpus. NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE COUNTRY OFFICE - confirm before this ships.

_docProvenanceComment: Primary-source citations per document. The 15 Jun xlsx Source column was empty for every row, so citations name the document and country only; no URLs, dates, or other details are invented. NAP/PPPP/NWRP/NFAP details (titles, years, ministries) are verbatim from each document's own front matter or executive summary; NMP details are verbatim from the document cover ('National Mineral Policy', 'Sri Lanka', '2026') and its 'Policy Name / Effective Date' page (effective 01.06.2026); its front matter names no issuing author (inquiries contact only), so author is omitted. Fields that the documents do not state are omitted.
_targetProvenanceComment: Target curation provenance: NDC/NBSAP/LDN and NAP/PPPP rows are expert-curated (data_sri_lanka_15Jun26.xlsx, data_sri_lanka_2Jul26.xlsx). The 16 NBSAP targets were replaced on 2026-07-28 with the CO's updated National Biodiversity Targets from data_sri_lanka_17Jul26.xlsx (sheet 'nbt'), which the CO delivered after the 17 Jul 2026 call with the request to update the analysis; each NBT now carries its own action lines as activities (123 in total, labels 'Action n.m' kept as activitySources sections). Two NBTs are renumbered relative to the 15 Jun set (old NBSAP_1 and NBSAP_2 are swapped), four carry wording changes, and the sheet's own numbering skips Action 3.3 (preserved, nothing renumbered). Ingest: ingest_sri_lanka_nbsap_17jul26.py. NFAP rows were extracted by the document-extraction pipeline (python/src/extract.py, gpt-5.4) on 2026-07-02, human-reviewed for provenance, and approved by a CO expert reviewer the same day: all 9 targets approved at target level with zero text corrections, and the 48 action lines she listed were added to activities (marked addedByReviewer in activitySources, each verified verbatim against the document; see commit 21672bc). NMP and NWRP rows are expert-curated from the CO colleague's 2 Jul 2026 17:03 extension of data_sri_lanka_2Jul26.xlsx (SharePoint version history): 55 NMP rows ingested 2026-07-03 (ingest_sri_lanka_nmp_3jul26.py), and 33 expert NWRP rows replaced the 46 pipeline-extracted NWRP rows, which were never expert-validated, on 2026-07-03 (ingest_sri_lanka_nwrp_swap_3jul26.py). The colleague's clause-level NFAP rows (118) from the same extension are deliberately NOT ingested: the reviewer-approved 9-target + activities structure stands, and 47 of her 48 action lines appear verbatim among those clauses (verified 2026-07-03) — same source material at a different granularity, no conflict.
